entry.summary: Fahrenheit to Celsius. Everyone knows the formula: C = (F - 32) * 5/9. But in practice, temperature conversion has nuances that trip up developers, scientists, and engineers regularly. Fahrenheit (F): Used in the US for weather, cooking, and everyday life. Water freezes at 32F, boils at 212F.
